title: Interaction
description: A dated meeting, call or exchange with its participants and its substance. Answers 'who said what, and when', and makes meetings countable. A training or a talk is a development_event, not an interaction — folding the two together would make every count of meetings wrong.

summary.description: What was actually exchanged — the substance, not the calendar entry

participants.description: Person IDs from _data/people/ — confirmed identities only

participant_names.description: Names mentioned but not yet resolved to a person record. Per ADR-008 a first name in a note creates no person; the reference stays text until the owner confirms the identity.
